# v3.25-dev

## Fixed

- **Training entries awaiting review no longer count towards your figures.** When a student import finds a training title that isn't in the catalogue, it creates a placeholder entry in the amber **"needs attention"** list. Those entries were being counted everywhere — the dashboard, every report, scheduled exports and the public API — as genuine **Certifications** in the **Sales** function under whichever product type happened to sort first. None of those values were chosen by anyone; the import invents them because the fields can't be left empty.

  The completions behind them are real, but filing real numbers under a category nobody picked inflated certification counts and skewed the by-product and by-function breakdowns. Unreviewed entries are now held back from reporting until an admin classifies them, and appear everywhere the moment they do.

- **Catalogue Health was the worst affected** — it listed every unreviewed entry as a catalogue item, complete with its placeholder classification and real completion counts.

- **Partner program compliance could pick these entries up on its own.** Requirements count everyone holding any catalogue variant of the required training, matched on Full Title and type. A freshly imported entry takes the imported title as its Full Title and `Certification` as its placeholder type, so one whose name matched a required certification's Full Title would join that requirement and add its holders to the attained count and the student drill-down — without anyone having configured it. Unreviewed entries are now left out of that match.

- **Unreviewed entries no longer appear in the training picker** when setting up program and offering requirements, which is how one came to be configured in the first place. They reappear once classified.

## Updated

- SuperAdmins now see a notice on the dashboard while any entries are awaiting review, saying how many there are and that they're excluded from the figures, with a link to sort them out — so the gap is visible rather than a silent under-count.

## Unchanged

- A learner's own record still shows every completion, including ones against entries awaiting review. Those completions genuinely happened; it's only the classification that's pending.
